This [[uniform polyhedron compound]] is a composition of two [[truncated tetrahedron|truncated tetrahedra]], formed by [[Truncation (geometry)|truncating]] each of the tetrahedra in the [[stellated octahedron]]. It is related to the [[cantic cube]] construction of the truncated tetrahedron, as {{CDD|node_h1|4|node|3|node_1}}, which is one of the two dual positions represented in this compound.

The [[vertex arrangement]] is the same as a convex, but nonuniform [[rhombicuboctahedron]] having 12 rectangular faces.
